en.headline: Cultural Centre foyer hosts free Asia+ music-box show
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department is listing the Asia+ Festival exhibition at the Cultural Centre foyer, with free entry.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department's Sunday programme lists the Asia+ Festival 2026 exhibition Sonic Odyssey of Curious Creatures at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre foyer from 9am.

The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and the department said in July that the fourth Asia+ Festival would run from September to November, with more than 100 performances and a thematic exhibition alongside workshops and outreach shows. Festival publicity describes three large music-box installations in the foyer — a peacock tower, a deer carousel, and a hummingbird and butterfly house — made with local curator Kay Chan Wan-ki and the collective Brainrental. Admission is free.

The festival is presented by the bureau and organised by the department, and draws programmes from across Asia and Belt and Road partners. This year's theme is a fresh reading of tradition and contemporary work. Performance tickets for the wider festival went on sale from 23 July.

zh.headline: 文化中心大堂展出亞藝無疆音樂盒裝置
zh.dek: 康文署今日節目表列出亞藝無疆專題展覽在香港文化中心大堂展出，免費入場。
body: 康樂及文化事務署周日節目表列出，「亞藝無疆」藝術節2026專題展覽《奇幻玩物的聲色巡禮》由今早9時起在香港文化中心大堂展出。
文化體育及旅遊局與康文署七月公布，第四屆「亞藝無疆」於九月至十一月舉行，帶來逾百場演出，並設專題展覽、工作坊及外展節目。藝術節宣傳指，大堂有三組大型音樂盒裝置，分別是孔雀塔、旋轉小鹿，以及蜂鳥與蝴蝶小屋，由本地策展人陳韻淇與創作團隊「大腦出租」製作，免費入場。
藝術節由文體旅遊局呈獻、康文署策劃，節目來自亞洲及一帶一路沿線伙伴。今年主題為「蘊藝新詮」，以新角度看傳統與當代。其餘演出門票由七月二十三日起發售。
